[2026-07-15] Workshop: “The Impact of Banking Reforms on Share Prices in the Iraq Stock Exchange” Under the patronage of Mr. Faisal Al-Haimus, Chairman of the Iraq Securities Commission (ISC), the Iraq Stock Exchange (ISX) organized a workshop entitled “The Impact of Banking Reforms on Share Prices in the Iraq Stock Exchange.” The workshop was attended by Ms. Nagham Hussein Ismail, Vice Chairperson of the Iraq Securities Commission; Mr. Dhulfiqar Hafez, Chairman of the ISX Board of Governors; Mr. Ali Jamal Amin, Chief Executive Officer of the Iraq Stock Exchange; together with representatives of relevant institutions, financial experts, and specialists to discuss the latest developments in the banking reform program and its implications for the financial sector and the stock market. Participants emphasized the importance of accelerating the implementation of the banking reform program, stressing that prolonged procedures adversely affect investor confidence, trading activity, and market liquidity. The workshop called on the Central Bank of Iraq (CBI) to expedite the implementation of the recommendations of Oliver Wyman, the consulting firm responsible for the banking assessment and reform program. Participants also recommended lifting restrictions on banks that had already fulfilled the required conditions and regulatory standards in order to promote regulatory fairness and restore market balance. The workshop further highlighted the need to promptly appoint human resources assessment firms for banks participating in the banking reform program, paving the way for the resumption of their remittance operations. The Iraq Securities Commission and the Iraq Stock Exchange announced their intention to prepare a package of official recommendations to be submitted to the Central Bank of Iraq, the Prime Minister’s Office, and Oliver Wyman, with the objective of ensuring that the proposed measures are taken into consideration as part of the ongoing reform process, while maintaining an appropriate balance between international compliance requirements and the protection of market stability and shareholders’ interests. 28

[2026-07-15] Workshop: “The Impact of the Remittance Initiative for Iraqi Banks Listed on the Iraq Stock Exchange Compared with Capital Increase Requirements” Under the patronage of Mr. Faisal Al-Haimus, Chairman of the Iraq Securities Commission, the Iraq Stock Exchange, in cooperation with the Iraq Securities Commission and the Central Bank of Iraq, organized a workshop entitled “The Impact of the Launch of the Remittance Initiative for Iraqi Banks Listed on the Iraq Stock Exchange Compared with Capital Increase Requirements” on Wednesday, 6 May 2026, at Al-Mahatta Hall.
